name: @heihei0299/pi-switch
description: Lightweight profile switcher for pi models.json

scripts.build: npm run build:webui && npm run build:go
scripts.build:webui: npm --prefix webui install && npm --prefix webui run build
scripts.build:go:current: go build -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=$npm_package_version -X github.com/heihei0299/pi-switch/internal/server.Version=$npm_package_version" -o bin/pi-switch-$(go env GOOS)-$(go env GOARCH) ./cmd/pi-switch
